author: Muséum d’histoire naturelle de La Rochelle
title: Muséum d’histoire naturelle de La Rochelle collection record for Kava Kava de doble cabeza — Paris, Francia

notes.text: The official page identifies and illustrates the museum's distinctive two-headed Rapa Nui statuette. Earlier research notes attribute inventory H.1529 to the museum's education dossier; that separate document was not re-examined in this batch. Pilot claims transcribe the heading and selected Caractéristiques cells in the preserved 29 September 2026 page, in French. “Inconnue” preserves the explicitly unknown production date. “P : 645 cm” is transcribed as published, without correction. Inventory H.1529 is absent, so no catalogue-number claim is extracted. The historical Toulouse loan notice (return expected at the end of 2019) and Salle 25 field are not used to assert a current location. “Propriétaire actuel” is not recast as held_by. Narrative interpretation and the other table fields were outside this small batch.

claims.value: Moaï kavakava de l'île de Pâques

captures.note: Named two-headed figure and description preserved. Inventory H.1529 is absent; anomalous dimension and historical loan wording retained as published. Main object image preserved; a bottom cookie banner and disabled video placeholder remain.
